d:
Aimen Dean, former MI6 spy, went from pledging allegiance to Osama bin Laden to dismantling Al-Qaeda from within.
He explains:
• How a teenager from Saudi Arabia went from schoolboy to Al-Qaeda bomb maker in under two years
• What Bin Laden was actually like in person and why his first meeting was a deep disappointment
• How al Qaeda radicalization works step by step victimhood empowerment then violent action
• Why he believes a single book inspired Al-Qaeda, ISIS, and the entire modern jihadist movement
